name: Chosen Or Elected
overview: Scripture reveals that while many are called to faith, only a few are chosen or elected by God, emphasizing His sovereign selection in salvation. This truth is affirmed in Jesus' teaching that the last shall be first, yet few are ultimately chosen, highlighting the distinction between being called and being elected. Additionally, Revelation portrays those united with Christ as called, chosen, and faithful, underscoring the victorious and faithful nature of the elect who follow the Lamb as King of kings.
